evidence.quote: The training of COUNTS proceeds in two distinct phases: an initial Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) phase to adapt the LLM to time series data and tasks, followed by a Reinforcement Learning (RL) phase to specifically cultivate chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities.

begins with a warm-up period where only the embeddings for the time series tokens are trained, keeping the rest of the LLM parameters frozen. This helps to gently align the new token representations with the LLM’s existing knowledge.
